rubric.explanation: Numeric v4: existing Economic/Environmental service rubric; Social 40% occupied housing, 40% service needs, 20% mean time-weighted site condition as an authored continuity proxy. Any recorded rain impact remains visible; tiny impacts do not imply a full year of lost service. Not measured welfare.

economy.assumptions: Scenario units, not measured population or utilities. Existing community outside project footprints: 4 homes, 4 jobs, 4 recreation, 4 local-service units. All eligible sites have fictional willing operators, access and utility connections. Drinking-water supply remains fixed; wastewater plants do not produce drinking water.

simulation.disclosure: Fictional scenario · weather and economic references: Coon Valley, Wisconsin · other parameters are authored game assumptions.
simulation.assumptions: All crop calendars/curves, site exposure and recovery coefficients are authored sensitivity assumptions. PRCP is liquid equivalent; May–October events with nonfreezing daily minimum are interpreted as illustrative rain. Other seasons/phase combinations are outside this disruption model, not zero real-world risk. Connections are existing hypothetical drainage groups. Source cultivated-cover fractions preserve partial fields when supplied; the sparse legacy fixture fallback explicitly assumes full cropped fields where prior output exists. No adjacency health effect is inferred. Solar and wind have separate constant generation assumptions because observations are unavailable.
